{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue_float == 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]

# Filter out QA rows
df_clean = df[~df['revenue_float'].isin([999999.99])]

# Count completed orders in clean data
completed_count_clean = df_clean['status'].eq('completed').sum()

# Verify the count
print(f"Number of QA rows identified: {len(qa_rows)}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding QA rows: {completed_count_clean}")

# Output the result
completed_count_clean"}
